name: release
summary: Release a version of an npm package: wait until the listed pull requests are merged, open and merge a version pull request with release notes, ask before the publish, push the tag v<version> on the merge commit, and wait until the tag CI publishes the version.

points.question: Who accepts the version pull request?

options.label: Greptile at 5/5
options.summary: Push the version branch and wait for Greptile to accept its commit at 5/5.
options.change: In release/accept.ts call reviewByAgent({ subject: subject, reviewer: { kind: "greptile" } }). release/round.ts opens or updates the pull request first and passes its immutable commit and target as subject. Declare github wait-review.

options.label: A person
options.summary: Wait for a person's approval of the immutable commit. Denial with feedback starts another bounded version turn.
options.change: In release/accept.ts replace the reviewByAgent import and call with reviewByPerson({ subject: subject }) from cloving/workflows/steps/review-by-person. Remove wait-review from methods.github in release.declaration.json. Set selection.accept to person in release/scenarios.ts.

options.label: A review turn
options.summary: Run the review profile and require its explicit accept verdict.
options.change: In release/accept.ts call reviewByAgent({ subject: subject, reviewer: { kind: "turn", profile: "review" } }). In release.declaration.json add run-turn:review to methods.claude, remove wait-review from methods.github, and configure the review profile. Set selection.accept to turn in release/scenarios.ts.

points.question: Who approves the publish after the merge?

options.label: A person approves
options.summary: After the merge, the decision "Publish v<version>?" waits for a person. A denial or an expiry pushes no tag.
options.change: Keep askPerson as approvePublish from release/publish.ts in release.ts. Keep selection.publish as person in release/scenarios.ts.

options.label: Publish after the merge
options.summary: Push the tag at once after the merge of the version pull request, with no decision.
options.change: In release.ts replace askPerson as approvePublish with afterMerge as approvePublish in the release/publish.ts import. Set selection.publish to merge in release/scenarios.ts.
